pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: centrally sponsored education schemes (Saakshar Bharat)

patterns: APPSC's favourite shape is a chairman match for the 10th-13th FCs (Pant, Khusro, Rangarajan, Kelkar); other PSCs ask single chairmen (1st Neogy, 12th Rangarajan, 14th Y.V. Reddy).
AP tilt: the 13th FC award apportioned between AP and Telangana under the AP Reorganisation Act 2014 (asked twice).
Devolution share per FC (12th 30.5%, 13th 32%) and award periods (13th 2010-15) are recurring single facts.
UPSC/UPPSC use statement items on 15th FC grants (Rs 4,800 cr education, tax effort reintroduced) and the 16th FC constitution date trap (2023 not 2024).
App MCQs track these well and add 16th FC weights and 2026 grant figures; criticism/opinion items are off-pattern.
